title: Blink Buffet
tagline: A one-thumb feast of green lights and very rude decoys.
description: The plate flashes a new order every round. Tap only the green bite before the kitchen timer snaps shut. The decoys get faster, the order gets stranger, and every clean streak makes the next serving smaller.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Blink Buffet. The plate flashes a new order every round. Tap only the green bite before the kitchen timer snaps shut. The decoys get faster, the order gets stranger, and every clean streak makes the next serving smaller.
